reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Diagnose with cam/crank correlation data and a listen test at cold start. Replace the timing chain tensioner (genuine Mercedes tensioner part number A2700521400 / 270-052-14-00, fits 2016-2023 M264/M270/M274) and, if the chain is stretched, do the full timing chain kit (Mercedes kit 0009935002 covers chain + guides). Use only OE-spec 0W-20/5W-30 (229.71) oil at correct intervals to prolong tensioner life. RepairPal estimates GLE350 tensioner replacement at ~$1,591-$2,121; full chain job runs higher.

reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Diagnose with cam/crank correlation data and a listen test at cold start. Replace the timing chain tensioner (genuine Mercedes tensioner part number A2700521400 / 270-052-14-00, fits 2016-2023 M264/M270/M274) and, if the chain is stretched, do the full timing chain kit (Mercedes kit 0009935002 covers chain + guides). Use only OE-spec 0W-20/5W-30 (229.71) oil at correct intervals to prolong tensioner life. RepairPal estimates GLE350 tensioner replacement at ~$1,591-$2,121; full chain job runs higher.

reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Distinguish normal light fog (clears with use) from a failed seal (droplets/pooling/tide-marks). reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Have the sunroof drain tubes flushed with low-pressure water or compressed air at each corner (a common wet-vac/blow-out service); replace degraded perimeter seals if leaking persists. For the rattle, re-seat or replace the drip-rail cover clips (often warranty/goodwill with a foam or double-sided-tape shim) and lubricate the sunroof guide rails with Mercedes-approved sunroof grease. Preventive drain cleaning every 1-2 years avoids interior water damage. Drain cleaning ~$100-200; seal/track service higher if headliner or trim is affected.

reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Start with a hard reset: lock the car, wait ~15 minutes, unlock and re-plug. Verify the 12V battery health (must be healthy to command HV charging) and check the charge-port door/latch for debris or corrosion. Test on a known-good EVSE/wallbox to rule out supply phase-imbalance. If a red-plug fault persists, a dealer XENTRY scan of the onboard charger/HV system and a software update are usually needed. DIY checks are free; dealer diagnosis/charge-port or software work $200-1,500.

reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: First check fuses F152/F154 and battery health, then perform the manual liftgate reset/re-initialization. Mercedes has a TSB for module fault B224E49 whose fix is a dealer software update and re-coding (no parts). If a spindle drive is mechanically failed, replace the passenger-side actuator; the rear-liftgate control module (genuine W166 part A1669008512 / 166-900-85-12) is the unit re-coded or replaced for control faults. Reset/recode is low cost; spindle-drive or module replacement $300-1,300.
